name: IT interrupt-retry
description: A retry of two attempts whose command adds a line to a file in the scratch directory and passes at its fourth start ever; the second start waits for a file of the test. For an interrupt inside the second attempt: a resume that went on counting attempts would have none left.

config.command: echo attempt >> "{{ scratch_dir }}/attempts.txt"; n=$(wc -l < "{{ scratch_dir }}/attempts.txt"); if [ $n -eq 2 ]; then w=0; while [ ! -e "{{ project_path }}/go" ] && [ $w -lt 900 ]; do sleep 0.1; w=$((w + 1)); done; test -e "{{ project_path }}/go" || exit 9; fi; if [ $n -lt 4 ]; then echo attempt $n fails; exit 1; fi; echo attempt $n passes
